hero.headline: I build e-commerce front-ends and connect them to the APIs behind them.
hero.summary: Almost five years at Linx with Vue.js and JavaScript, integrating search, personalized product showcases and ads into the websites of large retailers in Brazil.
hero.availability: Open to hybrid roles in Piedmont and Lombardy, or remote within Europe.

about.title: About me
about.text: I have been writing code since 2016: first custom web software in PHP and JavaScript, then e-commerce front-ends at Linx. I moved from Brazil to Italy, where I live with an EU long-term residence permit. Now I am updating my stack with TypeScript and Vue 3, and this site is part of that.
about.education: IT Technician, University of Santa Cruz do Sul (UNISC), 2016 – 2018

highlights: Built front-end features in Vue.js and JavaScript for search and personalized product showcases embedded in the websites of large e-commerce retailers in Brazil.
Integrated the Ads product into client websites while Ads was being migrated into the Impulse platform.
Checked metrics in MongoDB and debugged API calls with the browser network tools to make sure the data was correct.
The only front-end developer with write access to the central product-catalog parser, where I made changes.
Webhooks in JavaScript and Python, code review, and CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions and Docker.
IT support and consulting for Linux, Windows Server and networks.
Custom web software in PHP, JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
Full stack work with ASPX, PHP and JavaScript.
Data in Firebird and MySQL databases.

virgit.title: VirgIT · lesson platform
virgit.description: Web app built for a private Italian teacher and her students: a lesson calendar with drag-and-drop rescheduling and recurring lessons, lesson requests limited by her availability rules, student invites, homework with corrections, private materials, chat, in-app notifications and vocabulary review with spaced repetition.

hubLife.title: Hub Life · personal life dashboard
hubLife.description: The app I use every day to run my routine. It syncs steps, water and sleep from my smartwatch (Samsung Health) and weight from a smart scale, then updates my daily targets. The Gemini API estimates calories and macros from meal photos and turns voice messages into entries, including monthly expenses in euros and reais. Supabase keeps only the last 90 days; older data is archived as files in a GitHub repository.

portfolio.title: This portfolio
portfolio.description: Single-page site in Vue 3 and TypeScript, translated into English, Italian and Portuguese with vue-i18n. The repository list below is loaded live from the GitHub REST API. Built and deployed to GitHub Pages by GitHub Actions.

linxChallenge.title: Linx front-end challenge
linxChallenge.description: Hiring challenge from Linx: a responsive product showcase in plain JavaScript, HTML and CSS that loads products from a paginated REST API and keeps the extra results in memory to avoid unnecessary requests. The original demo is no longer online.
